about: Fill rules on a website: the person's "Never fill this field on this site" list, then the item's own rules (meta repo DESIGN.md, "Choosing what fills where"), as the browser extension applies them (passbundle-clients, apps/browser/src/autofill/keykeeper/fill-rules.ts, applyFillRules) and the apps' core does for Android's autofill (passbundle-apps, core/src/fill_rules.rs). Each case has a page (its scheme and host, its fields by their place, and its forms' names), an item, and the never-fill list as the settings document keeps it once it's opened. `fills` says which field gets which of the item's values (a rule's `fill`), and `never` which fields are kept empty; every other field is left to the generic matching. A field `rule` is kept as its JSON text. A case marked `apps` is for the apps only: a browser on Android may not say a page's scheme, which a page in the extension always has.
